scope: Selective primary-source coverage of microstructure features, execution constraints, ETF arbitrage, financial ML validation, and optional code references; not an exhaustive strategy inventory.
citation_format: Markdown [id] citations map to numeric source ids below. Ids retain the retrieval ledger numbering and are intentionally non-contiguous.
evidence_policy: Short verbatim excerpts were checked against retrieved full text or official repository files. Supports and limitations are paraphrases. Proposed TradeGuard safeguards in the report are research design recommendations, not measured results.
retrieval_notes: Audit fetched primary paper PDFs directly and extracted their text using pdftotext. The Cont–Kukanov–Stoikov file is arXiv v3, not v2; versioned URLs are now used for all three arXiv papers.
Purging/embargo rationale is verified on the author’s Innovations page. The detailed nested walk-forward procedure remains a proposed protocol, not a verbatim textbook replication.
CFTC Q&A supports its intent-based definition and CEA/DCM/SEF scope, not a blanket cancellation safe harbor or complete current equity law.
Official LICENSE and README references now use full commit SHAs. Qlib and LEAN share the already-recorded equity pins; MLforecast was pinned to the retrieved commit and re-fetched at that SHA.
No packages installed, binaries inspected, trading settings changed or broker actions performed. Code licenses do not establish market-data rights.
Native search/extraction failed; search used fallback providers and direct document retrieval. No separately callable web.run tool was exposed.
